method: Every USDC Transfer on Base into a host's pay-to addresses in the window counts; the addresses are those its own endpoints named on the sheet.
A repeat payer paid in two or more sessions, more than 900 blocks (30 minutes) apart.
A sweep paid in one session and, within 1,800 blocks (an hour), paid 5 or more of the other hosts read.
A self payer is one of the host's own pay-to addresses. Real payers are payers less sweeps and self payers.
An address more than one host names is a platform's and counts for none; an address with more than 20,000 transfers in the window is not read further. Counts only, never amounts or payers' addresses.
